T-152 is in review. The severity levels, a local Claude bug pipeline and the first weekly report are done. Five fix PRs (#160 to #164) and a CI PR (#165) are open on tantra-backend-v2 against `development`.

decisions.decision: Start now and don't wait for T-151. 1) Write docs/bug-pipeline/severity.md. Deadlines: P0 same day, P1 within 24 h, P2 within the week, P3 backlog. Include examples and the reporter notice for each level. Set Bharath as reviewer. 2) Clone Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2 (branch development) and tantra-mcp outside the repo. Build a local Claude pipeline (no n8n). It reads bugs from GitHub issues, from the T-151 queue once that exists, and from YOGI/PLANS/audits/FRONTEND_E2E_BUG_LOG.md. For each bug it sets severity, reproduces it, writes a failing test, then opens a fix PR with that test. 3) Open a PR adding a CI workflow that fails when a PR changes src/ without a test file. Ask Bharath to make it a required check. 4) Run the pipeline on 5 real bugs, so 5 PRs for Bharath to review. 5) Build the weekly report (open bugs by severity, time to fix, bugs that came back) and send its metrics to T-158. Post the first report on the board. Then move the task to review.
decisions.why: Under orchestrator-autonomy and build-fully-a[redacted], Claude builds end to end. Bharath (CTO) is owner and reviewer, so he signs off, not Adi. Old bug logs and GitHub issues give 5 real bugs without waiting for T-151. No credential, money or sign-in is needed.

decisions.decision: Most of this is already built on disk; close it out, don't restart. 1) Run `gh pr list -R Usetantra/tantra-backend-v2` to confirm PRs 160 to 164 are open against development, each with its regression test; re-push any that are missing. 2) Check whether a PR adding .github/workflows/regression-test-required.yml exists; if not, open it against development and ask Bharath in the PR body to make it a required check. 3) Fix the report in workshop-plan/bugs/pipeline.py: time to fix runs from triage to merge, so the five in-review bugs show 'none yet', not 0.0 h and not both open and fixed. State that the five bugs were found by code audit. Regenerate report-2026-10-09.md and metrics.json. 4) Post the report on the T-152 board, commit docs/bug-pipeline and workshop-plan/bugs, log the evidence links, set reviewer Bharath (severity sign-off, merges, required check), and move the task to review.
